name: TOB Bible Battle Rating
description: One row per user's Bible Battle competitive stats (BIR = Biblical Intelligence Rating), kept separate from the core User doctype. autoname=user so truth_of_bible.games.bible_battle.rating can get-or-create with a single frappe.get_doc('TOB Bible Battle Rating', user) call. System-Manager-only permissions — always read/written through truth_of_bible.api.bible_battle, never direct REST, so a player can never inflate their own bir/wins by PUTting this doctype.

fields.label: BIR
fields.description: Biblical Intelligence Rating. Every player starts at 1000; updated via an Elo-style formula after each completed battle (see games/bible_battle/rating.py).

fields.label: Current Streak
fields.description: Positive = consecutive wins, reset to 0 on a loss or draw.

fields.label: Total Points
fields.description: Lifetime sum of in-battle points scored, not a factor in bir itself — bir reflects competitive strength (wins/losses against opponent strength), not raw activity.
